faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Yes, during the beta: 1 free tailoring without an account, then 5 a month with a free account. The ATS checker is free with no sign-up. PDF and Word downloads are unlimited.
faq.a2: No. The model is forbidden from adding information, and an automatic check flags any number, date, degree or employer that isn't in your original resume.
faq.q3: What happens to my resume and my data?
faq.a3: Your file is never saved on our servers: it’s read in memory, analyzed, then forgotten. To perform the analysis, its text is sent to our artificial intelligence provider (Anthropic). If you create an account, we only keep your email and your number of tailorings this month. If you choose to, you can save a tailored resume to your history: its text is then kept for 90 days (or until you delete it), never the original file.
faq.q4: Does the score guarantee an interview?
faq.a4: No, no tool can guarantee an interview. The score measures how well your resume matches the job, based on evidence found in your resume, and shows you what to strengthen.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This page explains simply which data CV Woo uses, why, and how to exercise your rights (GDPR).
privacy.cvTitle: Your resume and the job offer
privacy.cv1: Your file is read in memory on our servers (Paris region) for the time of the analysis, then forgotten: it is stored neither on our servers nor in our database.
privacy.cv2: To perform the analysis, the text of the resume and of the offer is sent to our artificial intelligence provider, Anthropic PBC (USA). Under its commercial terms, Anthropic does not use this data to train its models and only keeps it temporarily, according to its own retention policy.
privacy.cv3: The preview and the PDF/Word export are generated on the fly and are not kept. Exception, only at your request: if you click “Save to my history”, the text of the tailored resume, the accepted changes and the job title are stored in our database (Supabase, Paris region) for 90 days, then deleted automatically. You can delete them anytime from the History page; they are also erased with your account. The original file is never kept.
privacy.account: If you create an account, we keep: your email address, your password (encrypted, never readable), your language and the date of each adaptation (to apply the monthly limit). Legal basis: performing the service you request. Duration: until you delete your account.
privacy.trial: For the free trial without an account, a signed cookie remembers that the trial was used, and the IP address is briefly kept in memory to limit abuse. Legal basis: our legitimate interest in preventing abuse.
privacy.cookies: We only use strictly necessary cookies, with no advertising or audience measurement: the login session (Supabase), the trial cookie “cvw_trial” (1 year) and the language cookie “NEXT_LOCALE”. They do not require consent.
privacy.processors: Vercel (hosting), Supabase (accounts), Anthropic (artificial intelligence analysis). No data is sold or used for advertising.
privacy.transfers: Vercel, Supabase and Anthropic are US companies. Any transfers of data to the United States are covered by the safeguards these providers set out in their terms (for example the European Commission's standard contractual clauses).
privacy.rights: You can access, correct or erase your data, object to its processing or request its portability. You can delete your account yourself from the Profile page, or write to us at {email}. If you believe your rights are not respected, you can contact the CNIL (cnil.fr).
